scope.03.0007: māṅ, juhotyādi, measure or sound in the root text. The Nyāsa explicitly derives mimīte with ślu and reduplication.
scope.01.1116: meṅ, bhvādi, praṇidāna. The Mādhavīya records exchange and, according to others, giving back as glosses. Haradatta is cited for retroflexion even without a visible ā in mayate.
scope.02.0057: The Nyāsa expressly sets aside adādi mā māne (māti), as well as the ā arising in forms of mī/min.
scope.04.0037: The digital Dhātupāṭha separately lists māṅ, divādi. The Mādhavīya says only some teach it and gives māyate. This packet counts the specific mimīte illustrated by 8.4.17. No general decision about divādi māyate in all prefix contexts is made.

law: The outer preverb supplies r, the inner prefix supplies n; 8.4.17 selects ṇ before the cited root. The Bhāṣya discusses aṭ intervention, giving the basis for praṇyamimīta versus praṇyamayata.
root_contrast: Across both prefix pairs the 72 pairs of same-lakāra/same-slot written outcomes in these four lakāras differ.
